usage.callShape: POST https://shieldform.waltsoft.net/verify with JSON body (form-submission signals); x402 payment via Base USDC ($0.005)
quirks: BROKEN: server-side x402 payment verification is non-functional. The unpaid 402 challenge is well-formed (x402 v2, exact scheme, Base USDC 5000 units = $0.005, valid payTo 0x318A...FD57), but after submitting a payment the server responds 402 {"error":"Payment verification failed"} on every attempt.
No USDC is actually spent — costUsd 0, no txHash, no settlement on both attempts. Safe to attempt but it will never succeed.

Body shape is irrelevant to the failure — both a populated body and an empty {} body produced identical 'Payment verification failed' responses; the rejection happens at the payment-verification layer, not input validation.
Do NOT retry repeatedly: it consistently fails verification.
usage.guide: Do not rely on this endpoint — it is broken. The x402 challenge looks valid (POST https://shieldform.waltsoft.net/verify, Base USDC $0.005), but the server's payment verification step rejects all payments with 402 {"error":"Payment verification failed"} and never settles a charge or returns a score. If the provider fixes verification, the intended call is POST with form-submission signals and the response would contain body.score (0-100), body.decision, and body.requestId. Until then it cannot be used.
